method: 内置图片生成；简化整站输入，局部校准后修正平台比例
visual_summary: 合并营业仓储的低层红黑主体、双罐与短检修廊、一处共用航空平台

prompts.status: 初始构图，保留后侧形体参考
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Minecraft Java 1.21.1 architectural building reference, ONE compact integrated industrial chemical supply terminal, HEC red and charcoal-black identity.
Only THREE main visual elements: a low warehouse with a small integrated reception at its front corner; TWO modest cylindrical storage tanks tucked against its rear/side with one short reachable maintenance gallery; ONE adjoining open-air cargo apron with a flush white H. Shared low ground plinth and a walking route around the apron. Storage categories are internal partitions, NOT separate buildings. Empty rooms and tanks, no furniture, cargo, machinery or vehicles.
Create a clean three-view sheet: large front three-quarter view, consistent opposite rear view, orthographic top plan. Show exactly the same layout in all views. Crisp vanilla voxel geometry, readable normal two-block-high wooden door leaves, full three-block-wide stair treads, one-block-thick frames, modest single-storey room proportions. A scale anchor must be visually recognizable, not dependent on a text label. Landing clear area needs25x25 blocks, free of overhead structures; warehouse roughly comparable to apron, tanks distinctly smaller than both. Preliminary site budget around60 long by36 deep and under22 high, flexible after reading local scale; do not print overall dimension labels or a fictitious numbered grid.
Deep red masonry/panels and dark deepslate roof/frame, neutral gray plinths, gray glass, thin safety-yellow lines, small warm lanterns. Layered sills, thin eaves, supported pipes and platforms, restrained industrial detail. No sprawling refinery, extra towers, separate offices, chimneys or ornamental buildings. No iron/gold/diamond/netherite/emerald blocks or beacons. Other vanilla materials allowed. Neutral studio background, soft daylight, no fog or foliage. Clear accessible door/stair relationships; interior fittings remain for later.

prompts.status: 入口与立面局部尺度参考
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is the design reference for this SAME HEC chemical terminal. Keep its three-element composition: red/black low warehouse with integrated reception, two tanks on the rear-right, one side H apron. Do not add buildings or machinery.
Make a SCALE-CORRECTED reference sheet: large orthographic FRONT elevation, orthographic TOP plan, and an entrance/stair CLOSE-UP. Use strict Minecraft voxel geometry and consistent block scale in all views. A normal wooden door leaf is visibly1 block wide and2 blocks tall; double door2x2. Adjacent masonry columns1 block thick; three-wide entrance stairs have four visible half-block rises. Warehouse front spans about twelve double-door widths; main wall about three door heights, roof another one block, modest single-storey. Tanks roughly four double-door widths in diameter, one taller than warehouse and one slightly lower. The apron clear square is25 blocks across, close to warehouse frontage width; its rectangle must look square in orthographic plan. Internal storage categories do not need drawing. Keep short gallery and safe people route outside H square. Draw discrete countable voxel edges in closeup, not texture seams.
Retain the reference's flat dark tiled roof, skylights, dark columns, red wall infill, inset windows, projecting black door canopy, tank rims and gray foundations. No overall dimension labels, no giant logo, no furniture. One overall footprint follows from these parts; do not stretch objects to a target bounding box. Neutral background, crisp vanilla block materials.

prompts.status: 采用整体体量关系；H 作业面按功能独立落实为25×25正方形
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. This is the adopted compact red/black HEC warehouse and twin-tank design. Make one final coherent three-quarter overview plus top-plan sheet. Preserve warehouse, reception door and tanks at exactly their present LOCAL block scale. The normal double door is2 blocks wide, warehouse frontage about24-26 blocks, tanks about9 and7 blocks diameter.
Correct ONLY the undersized H apron: its clear square must be25x25, so its width is approximately EQUAL to the warehouse frontage, not two thirds of it as drawn. Expand the apron and its low base to the right/front as needed, keep tanks at the rear and connected gallery, keep warehouse compact. Do not enlarge door, stairs, warehouse or tanks when extending the base. Walking route and two EMPTY marked equipment positions stay around the outside of the H square. No equipment huts, extra buildings or machinery. No overhead object above H. Keep the dark flat roof with three narrow skylights, deep red walls, charcoal piers and tanks, normal entrance. Background neutral, Minecraft-buildable geometry, readable block edges; no overall dimension numbers. This is a targeted pad-proportion correction, not a new design.
